#!/bin/bash
set -e

# Eval pipeline for Pythia-1.4B top-k k=50
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0
cd /root/autodl-tmp/recursive_gen_depth_est

DATA_DIR=\"data/pythia_topk50\"
FEATURES_PATH=\"${DATA_DIR}/features.jsonl\"
RESULTS_DIR=\"results/pythia_topk50\"
LOG_FILE=\"logs/eval_pythia_topk50.log\"
MODEL_PATH=\"/root/autodl-tmp/models/pythia-1.4b\"

mkdir -p \"$RESULTS_DIR\" logs

exec > >(tee -a \"$LOG_FILE\") 2>&1

echo \"=== Eval: Pythia-1.4B top-k k=50 ===\"
echo \"=== Started at \$(date) ===\"

# Step 1: Code contamination check
echo \"\"
echo \"=== Step 1: Code contamination check ===\"
for d in 1 2 3; do
    echo \"--- depth-$d (stats mode) ---\"
    python scripts/filter_code.py --input \"${DATA_DIR}/depth_${d}.jsonl\" --mode stats
done

# Step 2: Feature extraction (GPU)
echo \"\"
echo \"=== Step 2: Feature extraction ===\"
python scripts/extract_features.py \
    --data_dir \"$DATA_DIR\" \
    --model_path \"$MODEL_PATH\" \
    --output_path \"$FEATURES_PATH\" \
    --gpu 0 \
    --batch_size 16

# Step 3: Classification
echo \"\"
echo \"=== Step 3: Train classifiers ===\"
python scripts/train_classifier.py \
    --features_path \"$FEATURES_PATH\" \
    --output_dir \"$RESULTS_DIR\"

echo \"\"
echo \"=== Step 4: Filtered classification (remove code-contaminated) ===\"
# Filter code from depth 1,2,3
for d in 1 2 3; do
    python scripts/filter_code.py \
        --input \"${DATA_DIR}/depth_${d}.jsonl\" \
        --mode filter \
        --output \"${DATA_DIR}/depth_${d}_filtered.jsonl\"
done
# Copy depth_0 as-is (seed data, no filtering needed)
cp \"${DATA_DIR}/depth_0.jsonl\" \"${DATA_DIR}/depth_0_filtered.jsonl\"

# Extract features on filtered data
python scripts/extract_features.py \
    --data_dir \"$DATA_DIR\" \
    --model_path \"$MODEL_PATH\" \
    --output_path \"${DATA_DIR}/features_filtered.jsonl\" \
    --gpu 0 \
    --batch_size 16

# Hmm, extract_features looks for depth_{0,1,2,3}.jsonl by default
# Let me use a temp dir approach instead

echo \"\"
echo \"=== Eval complete! ===\"
echo \"=== Finished at \$(date) ===\"
SCRIPT_EOF
chmod +x /root/autodl-tmp/recursive_gen_depth_est/scripts/run_eval_pythia_topk50.sh"
